queries.label: vla-core
queries.why: Find VLA papers that directly model robot actions from vision and language.

queries.label: vla-named-models
queries.query: (all:RT-X OR all:Octo OR all:OpenVLA) AND all:"robot learning"
queries.why: Catch named robot foundation model families and comparative work.

queries.label: vla-open-x-embodiment
queries.query: (all:"Open X-Embodiment" OR all:"Open X Embodiment") AND all:robot
queries.why: Find cross-embodiment robot data mixtures that often form the real-robot layer of VLA data pyramids.
